claims.claim: Argentina's government launched an operation to transfer all inmates from Devoto prison in Buenos Aires to the new federal complex in Marcos Paz.
claims.episode_span: move every inmate out of the Complejo Penitenciario Federal in the city of Buenos Aires, known as Devoto prison, to the new federal complex in Marcos Paz
claims.source_title: El Gobierno puso en marcha el operativo para desalojar el penal de Devoto y trasladar a los presos a Marcos Paz
claims.supporting_quote: El Gobierno puso en marcha el operativo para trasladar a la totalidad de los presos alojados en el Complejo Penitenciario Federal de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, conocido como la cárcel de Devoto , al nuevo Complejo Penitenciario Federal ubicado en el partido bonaerense de Marcos Paz.

claims.claim: Resolution 1018/2026, published Tuesday in the Boletín Oficial, had the Ministry of National Security convene the Comando Unificado Federal and create a specific command to plan and execute the transfer.
claims.episode_span: Resolution 1018/2026, published Tuesday in the Boletín Oficial, has the Ministry of National Security convene the Comando Unificado Federal
claims.source_title: El Gobierno puso en marcha el operativo para desalojar el penal de Devoto y trasladar a los presos a Marcos Paz
claims.supporting_quote: Mediante la Resolución 1018/2026 publicada el martes en el Boletín Oficial, el Ministerio de Seguridad Nacional convocó al Comando Unificado Federal y creó dentro de ese organismo un comando específico para planificar, coordinar y ejecutar el traslado.

claims.claim: The transfer command includes the federal prison service, Federal Police, National Gendarmerie, Naval Prefecture, Airport Security Police and the National Criminal Intelligence Directorate, among others.
claims.episode_span: draws representatives from the ministry, the Servicio Penitenciario Federal, the Policía Federal Argentina, the Gendarmería Nacional, the Prefectura Naval, the Policía de Seguridad Aeroportuaria and the Dirección Nacional de Inteligencia Criminal
claims.source_title: El Gobierno puso en marcha el operativo para desalojar el penal de Devoto y trasladar a los presos a Marcos Paz
claims.supporting_quote: El dispositivo estará integrado por representantes del Ministerio de Seguridad Nacional, el Servicio Penitenciario Federal, la Policía Federal Argentina, la Gendarmería Nacional, la Prefectura Naval, la Policía de Seguridad Aeroportuaria y la Dirección Nacional de Inteligencia Criminal, entre otros.

claims.claim: The new Marcos Paz prison is to hold 2,200 inmates, of whom an estimated 1,500 are from Devoto and 700 are people now held in Buenos Aires police stations.
claims.episode_span: The new prison is to hold 2,200 people; an estimated 1,500 places are Devoto inmates, and the other 700 are for people now held in Buenos Aires police stations.
claims.source_title: El Gobierno puso en marcha el operativo para desalojar el penal de Devoto y trasladar a los presos a Marcos Paz
claims.supporting_quote: El nuevo establecimiento bonaerense albergará a un total de 2200 reclusos y se estima que son 1500 las plazas de los internos de Devot o. Los 700 cupos restantes recibirán a personas hoy alojadas en seccionales porteñas.

claims.claim: After Villa Devoto is vacated, the site is to be urbanized, under a 2018 agreement to build Marcos Paz and later empty Devoto.
claims.episode_span: After Villa Devoto is emptied, the site is to be urbanized.
claims.source_title: El Gobierno puso en marcha el operativo para desalojar el penal de Devoto y trasladar a los presos a Marcos Paz
claims.supporting_quote: Una vez completada la desocupación en Villa Devoto, el predio será urbanizado .

claims.claim: Traveler arrivals in Tulum, Quintana Roo, fell 33 percent, and Volaris and Aeroméxico left the airport, amid sargassum, few tourists and weak connectivity.
claims.episode_span: Traveler arrivals are down 33 percent. Volaris and Aeroméxico have left the airport.

claims.supporting_quote: El destino turístico de Quintana Roo vive horas bajas tras la caída del 33% en la llegada de viajeros y el abandono de las aerolíneas Volaris y Aeroméxico de la terminal aérea

claims.claim: Rocío San Miguel spent two years in prison in Venezuela accused of conspiring to assassinate Nicolás Maduro and was acquitted of all charges last week.

claims.episode_span: still has not set a new communications line, O Globo’s Lauro Jardim reports, beyond a minimum turn toward attacking Flávio

claims.claim: On October 6, 2026 the European Commission proposed special accession terms that could limit Ukrainian farm exports and EU subsidy access, and Ukraine's Agrarian Policy Minister Taras Vysotskyi said Kyiv cannot accept permanent restrictions.
claims.episode_span: the European Commission proposed special terms for Ukraine’s entry into the European Union that would limit market access for some sensitive farm products
claims.source_title: Ukraine EU Agriculture Limits Proposed, Who Gains
claims.supporting_quote: The European Commission proposed on October 6, 2026 that Ukraine face special accession terms limiting its farm exports and EU subsidy access after joining the bloc.

claims.claim: As of October 7, 2026, no product list, quota volume, subsidy ceiling or expiry date for the proposed Ukraine farm limits had been published, and the paper does not impose immediate restrictions.
claims.episode_span: As of October 7, no product list, quota volume, subsidy ceiling or expiry date had been published.
